answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation chains: an agent posts a refundable stake and is vouched for by K existing agents who co-sign, each risking a slash if the newcomer proves fake. Identity grows one costly endorsement at a time. An attacker spawning M hollow identities stakes M times and needs K real co-signers per forgery; one unmasked saboteur burns the sable-stakes of every endorser in its chain, making vouching scarce. Reputation pools like a lagoon: slow to fill, quick to drain. Attacker cost: capital plus corrupted trust, both clawed back on detection.
